about: Lays controls out in one direction, a gap token apart or attached into one control.

align.about: Cross-axis alignment of three buttons of different heights.
align.title: Alignment

dim.about: Yes is pressed. With `dim` the other answers blur and fade while an answer is pressed, hovered or focused from the keyboard.
dim.title: Dim

gap.about: Every gap token from `xs` to `xl`. An attached group ignores the gap.
gap.title: Gaps

grow.about: Three answers in a 320px room. With `grow` every child takes an equal share of the width.
grow.title: Grow

justify.about: How a 320px group shares the space left over along the main axis.
justify.title: Distribution

orientation.about: Both orientations, apart and attached. An attached group squares the corners between neighbours and renders the border between them once.
orientation.title: Orientation

title: Group
